quarterly_data.quarter: Murata press release: Murata Develops World's Smallest 008004-inch Size (0.25mm  (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Murata developed the NCU01 series, which it calls the world's smallest 008004-inch (0.25mm x 0.125mm) NTC thermistor: about 60% less mounting area than its previous smallest 01005-inch product with the same ±1% resistance and B-constant tolerances, for temperature monitoring in smartphones, wearables, IC packages and system-in-package modules. Sample shipments begin in October 2026 and mass production during 2027, starting with 100kΩ and 10kΩ values.
quarterly_data.figure: 0.25mm x 0.125mm; approximately 60% smaller mounting area; samples October 2026, mass production 2027
